The official Vercel docs describe Pro as a $20 monthly platform fee, not a flat per-seat price. The third-party sources mostly describe it as $20 per seat.

- **Official docs:** The Pro platform fee is $20 a month and covers one deploying team seat plus $20 in monthly usage credit. The platform fee is a fixed monthly fee that includes $20 in usage credit.
- **Additional seats:** A third-party pricing FAQ says extra deploying seats cost $20 each per month, while viewer seats are free. Additional deploying Owner or Member seats are $20 each per month; Viewer seats are free.
- **Usage beyond the plan:** Anything past the included allocations and credit is billed on demand, with 1 TB Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests included each month.
- **Pricing model change:** The official docs note that teams created on or after September 9, 2025, are on this pricing model automatically, while teams on the legacy Pro plan are still supported but will be moved to the new model later this year.
- **Caveat:** Several secondary sites still describe the older per-user $20 model, and one notes that by default, Vercel enables spend management notifications for new customers at a spend amount of $200 per billing cycle. Check vercel.com/pricing for current figures, since the sources disagree on the seat structure.

Vercel's Pro plan costs **$20 a month**. I couldn't load vercel.com/pricing (the fetch was refused), so this comes from search results, mainly the Vercel docs.

- **What the $20 covers:** It's a platform fee that includes one deploying seat and $20 of monthly usage credit.
- **Extra seats:** Each additional deploying seat (Owner or Member) is $20 a month. Viewer seats are free. This comes from a third-party pricing FAQ, not the official docs.
- **Included usage:** Each month includes 1 TB of Fast Data Transfer and 10M Edge Requests. Usage beyond the allocations and credit is billed on demand.
- **Older plans:** Teams created on or after September 9, 2025 are on this model automatically. Teams on the legacy per-seat Pro plan are still supported, but Vercel says they'll be moved to the new model later.
- **Where sources disagree:** Several third-party sites still describe the older model, which charges $20 per seat. Check vercel.com/pricing to confirm the current seat structure.
